submitted_fields.style: Instrumental urgent, fast full-time bittersweet electronica, 154 BPM, 4/4 in F major, around 3:30. One bar of thin 8-bit pulse keyboard repeats one pitch with silence. Round root-bass pulses and dry sampled big-beat drums enter in bar 2; a tiny two-note hook and thin reed-organ chords enter in bar 5. Target F - Am - Bb - Bbm, one bar per chord. Clear snare on beats 2 and 4, continuous eighth-note hats and firm kicks drive forward. One lead only: repeat the same two-note pattern with rests; no fills, solos, ornaments or countermelodies. Bass stays plain; organ supplies harmony only. Tender sadness with a warm lift, carried by thin game-like tones over energetic drums. Thin the organ for two bars while hats and bass continue, then restore the same hook with wider chords and stronger drums. Grow layers and force, never lead-note density.

submitted_fields.style: Instrumental urgent, fast full-time driving electronica, 156 BPM, 4/4 in B minor, around 3:30. Begin with two bars of thin 8-bit FM keyboard repeating ONE PITCH with silence. Plain root-bass pulses enter in bar 3; firm big-beat drums enter in bar 5 with clear snare on beats 2 and 4 and continuous eighth-note hats. A tiny two-note hook enters in bar 9. Target Bm - Em, two bars per chord. Thin warm string-synth chords support harmony only around the game-like FM lead. One lead only: repeat the same two-note pattern and rests; no fills, solos, ornaments or countermelodies. Bass stays plain and never runs. Exhilarating drums against an aching melody. A two-bar withdrawal keeps hats and bass moving, then restore the same hook with wider strings and stronger drums. Keep full-time momentum through the finish; add layers and weight, never lead-note density.
submitted_fields.exclude: vocals, audience noise, half-time groove, late drum entrance, long empty breakdowns, busy lead or bass runs, competing countermelodies, sixteenth-note arpeggios

Build hope through layers and chord color, never lead-note density.
